stdout:
Build kit for "Drawer"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        table-filter
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Flat row collection built around progressive filtering: a token bar that escalates into full query syntax, saved views that persist a filter set, column and grouping options, and a resizable detail pane.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template table-filter --type page <path>

name:        shell-side-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with a single collapsible, resizable left rail carrying grouped history and search, wrapping the main content.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-side-nav --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: ide (@astryxdesign/core), shell-side-nav (@astryxdesign/core), table-filter (@astryxdesign/core).

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        DrawerForm
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Compose a Layout with DrawerHeader, the fields in LayoutContent, and Cancel and Save in a pinned LayoutFooter.

name:        DrawerShowcase
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Open a modal drawer from a single trigger.

name:        DrawerScrim
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: The default modal drawer dims the page, traps focus, and closes on a scrim click.

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        Drawer
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A side panel that floats above page content for inspectors and detail views: the "click a table row, see its details" pattern.

name:        MobileNav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A slide-out drawer for mobile navigation.

name:        useDragToSnapPoints
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Lets a drag move an element along one axis and settles it on snap points when the finger lifts, the way an iOS sheet settles on its detents: on the nearest snap point to where it is, on the next one in its direction after a quick flick, and back where it started when the finger was moving back.
